chunks: Bakr ibn Muhammad narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said: I asked him about mutʿah.
So he said: “Indeed, I dislike for a Muslim man to leave this world while there remains upon him a practice from the practices of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله that he has not fulfilled.”

key_terms.أَكْرَهُ: I dislike; an expression of disapproval
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِ: the Muslim man being addressed in the ruling
key_terms.خَلَّةٌ: a trait, practice, or habitual sunnah left undone
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whose sunnah is being referenced
key_terms.لَمْ يَقْضِهَا: he did not fulfill or carry it out

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام encourage that a Muslim not leave an unfulfilled sunnah such as mutʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith presents mutʿah in connection with following the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. The Imam عليه السلام expresses dislike that a Muslim should depart the world while having left unfulfilled one of the prophetic practices.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4602 - Bakr ibn Muhammad narrated from Abu Abdillah (as): I asked him about Mut'ah (temporary marriage).

Imam (as) said: "Indeed, I dislike for a Muslim man to leave this world while there remains an unfulfilled practice from the practices of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) that he did not act upon."
